llm_response.reason: The website mimics the official Mobile Legends game site, asks for sensitive login credentials (Game ID, server ID, redemption codes, social account logins) by promising fake in-game rewards—classic phishing tactics. Community and authoritative sources widely warn against such sites as scams. The use of non-official domains for login/redemption, generic congratulatory/failure messages, and the targeting of psychological weaknesses (free rewards, urgency) all confirm it matches multiple scam indicators.
